mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window exceeds 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.2 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts improved corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of cases despite HOUST > 1.2M, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signal a broad-based demand surge that boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger a hawkish Fed response, leading to higher real rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of joint-triggered cases, or the interaction term's coefficient in a predictive regression is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage acceleration
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression framework.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 480k million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 55% of cases despite RSAFS < 480000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
